scenarios.title: 约朋友周六吃饭
scenarios.setting: 周四晚上，你想约同事周六一起吃饭，先问他周末有没有空。

lines.en: Hey, are you free this weekend?
lines.speak: Hey, are you free this weekend?

lines.en: Do you want to grab dinner on Saturday? We should catch up.
lines.zh: 周六一起吃个饭吗？好久没聊了。
lines.speak: Do you want to grab dinner on Saturday? We should catch up.

lines.en: How about around seven? Let's meet up near the subway.
lines.zh: 七点左右怎么样？我们在地铁口见。
lines.speak: How about around seven? Let's meet up near the subway.

scenarios.title: 临时改期再约时间
scenarios.setting: 周六下午你突然有事，要取消晚上的饭局，并改约到周日。

lines.en: Sorry, I have to cancel tonight.
lines.speak: Sorry, I have to cancel tonight.

lines.en: Yes, something came up at work. Can we do Sunday instead?
lines.zh: 还好，工作上临时有点事。改成周日可以吗？
lines.speak: Yes, something came up at work. Can we do Sunday instead?

lines.en: Yes. Let's meet up at seven near the subway.
lines.zh: 对。还是七点在地铁口见。
